name: [🌑 UPD 4] Souls Tycoon
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Souls Unleashed ! ⭐

Unlock different characters 🔥, fight against other players ⚔️, challenge powerful bosses and collect resources to improve yourself and finish your Tycoon! 💪

💾 Each Character has its own save file. Replay same character and keep your souls and money to continue building tycoon.
💎 Rebirth tycoon to unlock new powerfull character and gain more HP and Money!

💵 Join the group for +20% Money and Souls!
https://www.roblox.com/fr/groups/34995665

🎁 Codes: PART2

🎮 Use G to transform on PC or press Left Stick on console, on Mobile use keywords in chat (Bankai, Resurrection, Voltstanding)
